AntiPattern.Bad: Story title `'Components/Button'` or `'UI/Button/Primary'` — hierarchy invented by developer.
AntiPattern.WhyBad: Hierarchy not derived from spec (`AX_HIERARCHY_MIRRORS_SPEC`). When the spec adds a new appearance, the developer must manually reorganize stories. The spec and Storybook drift apart silently.
AntiPattern.Good: Title `'Button/Accent/Primary'` — matches spec's Variants table columns. Adding a new appearance is a mechanical addition of one title group.
